messages:
ana: Quick report: onboarding run for horizon-32k-int8 showed subtle punctuation shift after KV handoff between shards. Not a catastrophic divergence but fails our strict goldset.
matt: can you paste the minimal repro and exact env?
\yana: repro summary: generate with seed (attached), prefill ~18.5k tokens, trigger shard-swap handoff, then resume. Observed changed token at pos ~18512 ("," -> ", "). Happens ~40% of runs on int8 canary, <5% on fp16.
yejin: interesting. any difference when using global-prefix-cache vs per-token cache?
\yana: toggled: prefix_cache=per-token (default) shows higher failure. prefix_cache=global reduces frequency. Also chunk_size=1024 is worse than 2048.
sasha: could be quantized dot-product noise + RoPE index rounding at boundary. Did you try forcing rotary_index_remap?
\yana: yes: set ROTARY_REMAP=1 reduces but doesn't eliminate. Also noticed runs that fail have slightly different kvcache checksum after resume. snippet: ```
[2025-01-12T09:10:11Z] INFO kvcache: resume shard=1 span=18432-18688 checksum=0x4b2d1a
[2025-01-12T09:10:11Z] WARN token-compare pos=18512 expected="," got=", \n```
matt: assign this to me. I'll run a matrix: quant=int8,int4,fp16 x cache=per-token,global x chunk=512,1024,2048 with 5 seeds. Will upload artifact links. ETA tomorrow morning.
yejin: also try "force-stable-quant" runtime flag (adds deterministic rounding at KV write) — might surface performance impact but good triage.
sasha: if matt can't reproduce offline we should enable ktrace around the remap path and capture raw rotary index values for positions 18496..18528. I can help with that.
kv-bot: buildbot: canary horizon-32k-int8-20250112.0412 queued on qa-dedicated.
matt: noted. I'll include diffs of kvcache checksums pre/post handoff, and compare vector l2 norm around mismatch.
yejin: FYI I ran a tiny quick-check with force-stable-quant and it removed the mismatch for one seed but increased tail latency by ~4%. Worth tradeoff discussion.
nana: (typo) meant ana: thanks all — adding ticket INF-4281, label: kv-handshake, priority: high. Link + seeds in ticket.
matt: OK starting runs now. Will post logs + raw dumps to the jira and ping when done.
sasha: if we confirm root cause = rounding at write, patch idea: add 1-byte metadata check on handoff (hash of rotary indices) to reject inconsistent handoffs and fallback to re-prefill. Less invasive than stable-quant.
yejin: agreed. Good mitigation path.
nana: (again, ana) filed mitigation note in INF-4281. Leaving to matt + sasha.
matt: will update here with results.
